name: Multi-Species Ecosystem + Shared Resources + WORLD<->ECO Feedback

north_star.goal: Evolve a deterministic multi-species ecosystem whose structure emerges from physical environment, shared resources, inter-species interactions, disturbance and bounded ecology-to-environment feedback rather than authored biome outcomes.
north_star.player_visible_goal: A player can stand in or fly over one physical region, accelerate ecological time, observe species redistribution and morphology change, apply a disturbance, and watch recovery or succession without scripted target biomes.
non_goals: direct ECO writes to canonical WORLD state
per-world retuning in the final challenge

species_catalog.purpose: Frozen research input defining multiple functional species without encoding target biome placement.

environment_feedback_proposal.purpose: Permit WORLD<->ECO feedback without granting ECO world-write authority.
environment_feedback_proposal.application_rule: WORLD owner may apply a validated bounded proposal and publish a new immutable environment snapshot; ECO only consumes that next snapshot.

roadmap.name: Multi-Species Ecology
roadmap.goal: Run at least three functionally distinct species through the same LS3 spatial ecology without desired-biome placement.
roadmap.visual_gate: LS4-VIS1 species distribution and lineage/species overlay

roadmap.name: Interaction Graph
roadmap.goal: Add deterministic typed inter-species causal edges while preserving canonical identities and fail-closed unknown kinds.
roadmap.visual_gate: LS4-VIS2 interaction graph and per-cell interaction pressure overlay

roadmap.name: Shared Resource Competition
roadmap.goal: Make light, water, nutrients and space explicit bounded shared resources whose allocation changes survival and reproduction.

roadmap.name: Trophic Network
roadmap.goal: Support population-level producer/herbivore/predator/decomposer energy-flow interactions without individual-agent AI.

roadmap.name: Disturbance Envelope
roadmap.goal: Apply bounded deterministic drought/flood/fire/frost/excavation/impact events and prove exactly-once causal effects.
roadmap.visual_gate: LS4-VIS5 disturbance footprint and before/after ecology

roadmap.name: Ecological Succession
roadmap.goal: Observe unscripted recovery trajectories and phase changes after disturbance.
roadmap.visual_gate: LS4-VIS6 succession timeline and phase overlay

roadmap.name: Ecosystem Engineering
roadmap.goal: Derive bounded ecological effects on shade, water retention, organic matter, soil stability and surface roughness as proposals only.

roadmap.name: WORLD<->ECO Feedback Loop
roadmap.goal: Round-trip validated feedback proposals through the external environment owner and re-ingest the resulting immutable environment snapshot without ECO gaining WORLD authority.

roadmap.name: Emergent Ecosystem Challenge
roadmap.goal: One frozen catalog/ruleset and founder setup must produce distinct deterministic ecosystems on at least three physical worlds, survive a bounded disturbance challenge, and show unscripted recovery/succession without per-world tuning.

acceptance_policy.performance_regression_rule: Accepted PERF2.CONV workload remains an immutable regression baseline; each LS4 substage must freeze its own added-workload budget before runtime acceptance.
acceptance_policy.working_set_rule: No unbounded per-generation or per-species history/cache may be introduced; any retained history or cache must declare an explicit bound and eviction semantics.
acceptance_policy.visual_rule: Presentation is derived-only and must never become ecology, world, persistence or network authority.
